items.title: Suspicious material decontamination
items.beforeAlt: Before: building area with suspicious materials and potential contamination
items.afterAlt: After: area treated cleanly and prepared for the next phase of work
items.description: Decontamination work with containment, targeted material removal and proper preparation of the area so the project can move forward.

items.title: Cleanup after mould contamination
items.beforeAlt: Before: interior affected by humidity and mould with deteriorated surfaces
items.afterAlt: After: sanitized surfaces and area prepared for the next stage of work
items.description: Removal of affected sections, control of contamination and preparation of the area for a clean and structured continuation of the project.

items.title: Sampling before work begins
items.beforeAlt: Before: suspicious materials that need confirmation before work starts
items.afterAlt: After: clear report with analysis results and recommended next steps
items.description: Material sampling and laboratory coordination to confirm the presence or absence of contaminants before decontamination or demolition.

items.title: Interior selective demolition
items.beforeAlt: Before: interior sections that must be removed in a controlled way before the next stage
items.afterAlt: After: area opened cleanly and prepared for the next intervention
items.description: Targeted removal of selected materials, protection of areas to keep and cleanup of the work zone before the next phase.

items.title: Vermiculite removal
items.beforeAlt: Before: visible vermiculite in a building area that must be treated
items.afterAlt: After: vermiculite removed and area cleaned properly
items.description: Safe vermiculite removal in a targeted area with clean handling of materials and preparation for the next stage of the project.

items.title: Hazardous material assessment
items.beforeAlt: Before: situation that must be clarified before intervention on the property
items.afterAlt: After: clear summary of affected areas and site priorities
items.description: Review of the file, validation of suspicious materials and direction toward sampling, decontamination or demolition depending on the need.
